doctor.bio: Dr. Lakkappa S. Ganiger is an accomplished dental surgeon with specialisation in full mouth rehabilitation, smile designing, crown & bridges, dentures, implants and maxillofacial prosthesis. Dr. Ganiger's unwavering commitment to providing exceptional care ensures that his patients attain optimal oral health and a confident, beaming smile.

about.heading: About the Doctor
about.patientsSummary: Since the clinic opened in 2021, Dr. Ganiger has treated more than 10,000 patients.

memorial.heading: In loving memory of Shri Shivappa Ganiger
memorial.photoAlt: Shri Shivappa Ganiger, Dr. Ganiger's late father
paragraphs: Dr. Lakkappa S. Ganiger owes his journey into dentistry to his late father, Shri Shivappa Ganiger. He believed that education could change a family's future, and he stood behind his son's studies at every step — from school in Ainapur to a master's degree in dentistry.
For the family, his faith in education was nothing short of a revolution. The care every patient receives at this clinic carries forward the legacy he began.

contact.heading: Contact & Appointments
contact.intro: Reach us by phone or WhatsApp, visit either branch, or send an appointment request below.
contact.formIntro: This is a request, not a confirmed booking. Clinic staff will call you to confirm the date and time.

form.name: Full name
form.phoneHint: 10-digit Indian mobile number. We will call this number to confirm.
form.dateHint: We will try to match your preferred date; the clinic will confirm the final time.
form.messageHint: A short note is enough (for example, “tooth pain” or “check-up”). Please do not share detailed medical history here.
form.consent: I agree that the clinic may contact me by phone or WhatsApp about this request.
form.errorDelivery: Sorry, we could not send your request just now. Please try again, or call or WhatsApp the clinic directly.
form.errorRateLimited: Too many requests from this device. Please wait a while, or call or WhatsApp the clinic directly.
form.successBody: Thank you. Your appointment request has been sent to the clinic. This is not yet a confirmed booking — clinic staff will call you on the number you gave to confirm the date and time.

errors.name_invalid: Please enter a valid name (2–80 characters).
errors.phone_invalid: Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.
errors.date_past: Please choose today or a future date.
errors.date_too_far: Please choose a date within the next 90 days.
errors.date_closed: The selected branch is closed on that day. Please choose another date.
errors.message_too_long: Please keep the note under 500 characters.
errors.consent_required: Please tick this box so the clinic can contact you.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you send an appointment request, we collect only your name, mobile number, preferred branch, an optional preferred date and an optional short note about the reason for your visit.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: Your request is sent by email to Dr. Ganiger's clinic so that staff can call you to arrange an appointment. It is not used for advertising and is not sold or shared with anyone else.

sections.heading: Service providers
sections.body: The website is hosted by Netlify and requests are delivered by the email service Resend. These providers process the request only to deliver it to the clinic.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Questions or deletion
sections.body: To ask about or delete information you have sent, contact the clinic by phone or at lakkappaganiger34@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Appointment requests
sections.body: Sending the form on this website is a request for an appointment, not a confirmed booking. Clinic staff will call you on the mobile number you give to confirm a date and time. Please do not come to the clinic for a requested time until it has been confirmed.

sections.heading: Not medical advice
sections.body: The information on this website is general and is not a substitute for an examination by a dentist. Please do not rely on it to diagnose or treat a condition. For pain, swelling or an injury, call the clinic directly.

sections.heading: Timings and holidays
sections.body: Branch timings are shown as accurately as possible but can change, and the clinic is closed on national holidays. Please call before travelling if you are unsure.

sections.heading: Using this website
sections.body: Please send requests only for yourself, or for someone who has agreed to it, and give correct details. Requests that look automated or abusive may be ignored.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: For any question about these terms, contact the clinic by phone or at lakkappaganiger34@gmail.com.
